Introduction
This document outlines the inspection check 
 list I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sawsan

Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the personal
 protective equipment as (safety shoes, Helmet).
Turbine shout down & all MCC CB off 
 (racked out).
Tools and Equipment
Digital AVO Meter, Frequency meter, Remover card.
Speed tronic calibrator set 
 model (151A4925)
Special tool to adjust the 
 potentiometer at the cards
Work to be Carried Out
Turbine Speed Sensor
PR/A: Pulse Rate / Analog 
NHP: normal Speed
Magnetic Pickup ( 77HC1 , 77HC2 )
Check 
 DC resistance shod be (140Ω).
Check wires for grounding.
Check that the sensor 
 wires are healthy.
Speed 
Control Card SSZB (1L 1I )
Inject frequency source from 
 calibrator at pin (1C, 2B) at 100%, to reach NHP (5105) RPM.
Ensure that voltage at 5H,G 
 read 10 V dc
If it is not correct adjust 
 from (R112).
Pull card SFPB at 1L 1P.
Make Jumper max1, 
 max2 pin (34 & 35) at card SSKC to max. (VCE).
Adjust 100% NHP until speed 
 control light just comes on. If it is not correct adjust from (R112) according 
 the table blow
0
0 
 0.01
---
Full Speed No Load (FSNL)
Remove card SFPB.
Set 100% NHP 5105 r.p.m.
Measure VCE 7H,1G at 
 calibrator as given in sitting (3.4 volt) if it is not correct. Must be 
 adjusted from FSNL R207 at SFPB card.
Droop 104%
Set 100% (NHP) by 1C , 2B at 
 calibrator
Raise D.S.P to 104 at 4 volt
Ensure that VCE =16.3 or 8 
 volt.
If it is not correct. it must 
 be adjusted from DROOP R209 at card SFPB.

FSNL, "SFPB" R207
DROOP R209

unit = 3.8 volt

Put cards in normal position
